title: 第一卷 第15章 领证第一卷 第16章 上门女婿
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧

叶青云点头。
“没错，正是《唐后行从图》的真迹。”
林迎夏闻言，脸色一冷。
当即指着叶青云喊道。
“好啊！第一次见面，你就拿赝品来糊弄我姐？”
叶青云眉头一皱。
“这是真迹。”
“你放屁！”
林迎夏冷声道，对其余人解释道。
“《唐后行从图》的真迹已经被杰哥的父亲送给了‘黑玫瑰’。
这件事可是杰哥亲口告诉我的！
叶青云，你说你这一副画不是赝品，
那你的意思就是你这一副画是从‘黑玫瑰’的手里拿来的喽？”
林迎夏说到后面，忍不住发出嗤笑。
就面前这个怂包，敢从黑玫瑰的手中抢《唐后行从图》？
想想都不可能！
林迎夏心中寻思。
以叶青云的胆量，没准他在黑玫瑰面前，都会被吓尿。
叶青云耐着性子回了句。

“我手上这幅就是真迹。”
林秋月柳眉一皱。
《唐后行从图》的真迹她略有耳闻，市场价值上千万。
就叶青云的衣着怎么也不像是能拿出上千万的人。
年轻人好面子！
林秋月心中有了定夺。
这让她对叶青云心中的好感降低不少。
男人的面子要靠努力争取。
而不是靠赝品来满足虚荣心。
林弘义过来打圆场。
“好了，这幅画再怎么说，也是青云的一番心意。
你们少说两句。
迎夏，你去把这幅画放到我书房，我很喜欢。”
他心中大抵也不相信叶青云这一幅画是真迹。
毕竟真迹在黑玫瑰手里！
“爸，你书房里都是书法大家的作品。
放着一个地摊货进去，实在太掉面了。”
“就你话多，赶紧去做！”
林弘义脸色一板。
林迎夏撇撇嘴。

随意地拿起茶几上的这幅《唐后行从图》，前往林弘义的书房。
一直打量叶青云的吴贞兰开口道。
“青云，你现在是什么工作？”
“我跟师父在山上修行，昨日刚下山，现在还没有工作。”

Ye Qingyun nodded.
"That's right, it's the authentic copy of "The Journey of the Empress of the Tang Dynasty"."
Lin Yingxia's face turned cold when she heard this.
He immediately pointed at Ye Qingyun and shouted.
"Okay! When we first met, you fooled my sister with a fake?"
Ye Qingyun frowned.
"This is authentic."
"You fart!"
Lin Yingxia said coldly and explained to the others.
"The original copy of "The Journey of the Empress of the Tang Dynasty" has been given to the 'Black Rose' by Jie Ge's father.
Brother Jie told me this personally!
Ye Qingyun, you said this painting of yours is not a fake.
So what do you mean, you got this painting from the 'Black Rose'? "
Lin Yingxia couldn't help but sneer when she said the last part.
The coward in front of me dares to snatch "The Journey of the Empress of the Tang Dynasty" from Black Rose's hands?
It’s impossible even to think about!
Lin Yingxia was thinking in her heart.
With Ye Qingyun's courage, he might be scared to death in front of Black Rose.
Ye Qingyun replied patiently.
"The painting I have is the real one."
Lin Qiuyue frowned.
She had heard a little bit about the original "The Journey of the Empress of the Tang Dynasty", and its market value was tens of millions.
Ye Qingyun's clothes don't look like someone who can afford tens of millions.
Good face young man!
Lin Qiuyue made a decision in her heart.
This made her impression of Ye Qingyun much lower.
A man's face must be earned through hard work.
Instead of relying on fakes to satisfy vanity.
Lin Hongyi came over to smooth things over.
"Okay, no matter what you say, this painting is still Qingyun's intention.
Just say a few words.
Yingxia, go and put this painting in my study. I like it very much. "
He probably didn't believe that Ye Qingyun's painting was authentic.
After all, the original work is in the hands of Black Rose!
“Dad, your study is full of works by master calligraphers.
It's really embarrassing to go in with a street stall. "
"You're the only one who talks a lot, so hurry up and do it!"
Lin Hongyi's face was stern.
Lin Yingxia curled her lips.
I casually picked up the painting "The Journey of the Empress of the Tang Dynasty" on the coffee table and went to Lin Hongyi's study.
Wu Zhenlan, who had been sizing up Ye Qingyun, said.
"Qingyun, what's your job now?"
"Master and I are practicing in the mountains. We just came down yesterday and we have no work yet."
